lines.trans: Chef, a guest out there found a cockroach in his dish.
A cockroach again, whose dish is it?
It is your dish again, Chef.
Quieter, he was just yelling at a cat.
Quickly catch up with my car, mine!
Here is a thousand rubles for you right away.
If you catch up, I will give you five thousand.
Well that is it, let us go quickly!

examples.text: Иногда нам нужно принимать сложные решения.
examples.trans: Sometimes we need to make difficult decisions.

examples.text: Бороться за свою любовь или опустить руки.
examples.trans: To fight for our love or give up.

examples.text: Или просто искать новую цель.
examples.trans: Or simply look for a new goal.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ейчас').

examples.text: Что, где он сейчас?
examples.trans: What, where is he right now?

examples.text: А давай сейчас у Макса спросим.
examples.trans: Let us ask Max right now.

examples.text: Макс, пожалуйста, не начинай сейчас.
examples.trans: Max, please, do not start right now.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'to, towards', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Бороться за свою любовь или опустить руки.
examples.trans: To fight for our love or give up.

examples.text: Или просто искать новую цель.
examples.trans: Or simply look for a new goal.

examples.text: Меня только что толкнул наш Кузьма.
examples.trans: Our Kuzma just kicked me.

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'I'll get out', paired with 'выходить'.

related.gloss: not to I'll get out (negated infinitive)

examples.text: Сейчас я сам к нему выйду.
examples.trans: Right now I will go out to him myself.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks.

examples.text: Он вышел из дома.
examples.trans: He left the house.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'faster', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Ладно, давай быстро иди работать.
examples.trans: Alright, go on and get to work quickly.

examples.text: Давай быстро уезжаем отсюда!
examples.trans: Let us drive away from here quickly!

examples.text: Я в порядке, быстро отпусти меня.
examples.trans: I am fine, let me go quickly.
